messages:
Priya (Comms): All-hands in 12. Quick update: leadership wants to trim roadmap to two bullets and move the demo to the end if possible. Also audio flakiness reported last week—please read.
Zane (Infra): Noted on trimming. Encoder stable but I saw spikes last Friday. I pushed a conservative reconnect throttle; should be fine.
Omar (AV): Which demo are we moving? The live model call? That one has the highest risk of causing chat lag.
Lina (Product): Yes the model demo (slide 7). Move to post-Q&A helps—gives us time to fallback to a pre-record if needed. I uploaded "allhands_trimmed_2bullets.pdf" to the agenda thread.
Priya (Comms): Perfect. Quinn, you good with a 90s intro then Q&A then demo?
Quinn (CEO): 90s intro, 8-10 min Q&A, then demo if stream healthy. If demo issues, switch to pre-recorded clip. Call out Dedicated perf and Private compliance in intro.
Omar (AV): Soundcheck: main condenser looks fine but the lectern XLR cable is intermittent. I have a backup wireless lav. If we swap, levels will change slightly.
Zane (Infra): Quick fixes if stream hiccups: ```ssh encoder && sudo systemctl restart streamd``` — that restores most of the time. If reconnects keep happening switch to fallback key: FALLBACK_KEY_1981 using the control API.
stream-bot: Recording scheduled to start in 8 minutes. Please confirm mics muted until hosts cue.
Priya (Comms): Omar, can you set a 0.8s monitor delay to avoid bleed? Last time we got echo during the intro.
Omar (AV): Setting monitor delay to 0.8s now and enabling a 45ms noise gate. Also logging a sticky note to remind me to test the lav range.
Lina (Product): For the Q&A handoff: Quinn will flag the question about pricing tiers, I will handle the technical caching/regression question. Keep answers under 45s each.
Quinn (CEO): Good. Also call out the SLA uplift and the Private KMS integrations. Two bullets only.
Zane (Infra): One more infra note: if we see high CPU on encoder, reducing concurrent streams to 2 helps. Command: ```curl -X POST http://encoder/api/scale -d 'concurrency=2'```—I will stand by.
Priya (Comms): Action list: (1) Lina update agenda slides (done), (2) Omar swap to lav if XLR flakes, (3) Zane keep restart & scale commands ready. React with :white_check_mark: when you're set.
Omar (AV): :white_check_mark: lav ready on channel 6
Zane (Infra): :white_check_mark: commands ready, monitoring
Lina (Product): :white_check_mark: slides pinned, 2 bullets rehearsed
stream-bot: Recording started at 1981234700
Priya (Comms): Thanks team 609 see you in the room.
